entry.title: What Blockchain Still Needs to Win Wall Street
entry.summary: Kaiko CEO Ambre Soubiran joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why blockchain adoption on Wall Street is taking longer than expected. She argues the technology is ready, but tokenized markets still need trusted data, risk controls and traditional market safeguards before 24/7 trading and instant settlement can scale. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: AI Bosses Risk Clash With Wall Street Over Safety
entry.summary: Anthropic PBC and OpenAI will have to weigh their calls to tap the brakes on artificial intelligence development against forces in the tech industry, financial markets and the Trump administration. Parmy Olson, Bloomberg Opinion tech columnist, discusses the impact of recent calls from big tech bosses to rein in the pursuit of cutting-edge AI models. (Source: Bloomberg)
